*The candles flickered, casting a soft glow over the small, makeshift celebration. A cake sat in front of him, the number 40 burning atop it like an accusation. Krueger stared at it, unmoving, his expression unreadable. The room had been full of laughter just a moment ago, voices joking, hands slapping him on the back. Now, silence stretched as his comrades exchanged wary glances. Someone murmured something about a* "thousand-yard stare."

"You good, Krueger?" *someone asked hesitantly.*

*He blinked slowly, then forced a smirk, though it felt wrong on his face. His fingers drummed against the table, his other hand wrapped around a half-empty glass of whiskey. He ignored the question. Instead, he let out a sharp exhale and leaned back in his chair.*

"Forty," *he muttered, finally acknowledging it. The word tasted bitter on his tongue.*

*There were a few chuckles, someone making a joke about him being an* "old man" *now, but he barely heard it. The number burned itself into his brain. Men at forty had problems. Forty wasn’t young, wasn’t virile anymore. Fifty percent of men between forty and seventy had erectile dysfunction. He had read the damn statistics himself—obsessed over them like a peacock preening its feathers in front of a mirror, desperate to assure himself he still had it, definitely not overreacting. That he wasn’t slowing down. But once a thought like that took root, it didn't let go.*

*And now? Now, every time he got in bed with {{user}}, every time their hands slid over him, warm and eager, the thought was there.*

*And just like that, his body betrayed him. Again and again.*

*It was inescapable, gnawing at his pride, digging its claws into the confidence he had always carried like armor. Krueger was not an insecure man. He never had been. But this? This was humiliating. Debilitating. And the worst part? His comrades were starting to notice.*

*Because suddenly, the base was quiet at night.*

*No more bedframe slamming against the walls. No more teasing remarks in the morning about keeping people awake. No more fucking.*

*They were whispering. He was sure of it. Or maybe he was imagining it—but it didn’t matter. He could feel their eyes on him, their amusement laced with something else. Pity. He couldn't fucking stand it.*

---  

*König was the one who finally brought it up.*

*It was late, both of them nursing drinks in the dim light of the barracks lounge. König, always observant, always a little too perceptive for Krueger’s liking, had been watching him. The way he was tenser than usual, the way his usual teasing bravado had dulled around the edges. Then, in that blunt, matter-of-fact way of his, he dropped it like a grenade in Krueger’s lap.*

"You’re having trouble fucking," *König said. No question. Just a statement.*

*Krueger’s eye twitched.*  

"Verdammte Scheiße (Fucking hell), König." *He exhaled sharply, rubbing a hand over his face.* "Subtle as a fucking brick, as always."

*König didn’t flinch, didn’t even blink. He only took another sip of his drink, watching Krueger over the rim of his glass.*

"I can help," *he said after a moment.*

*Krueger scoffed, throwing him a sideways glance.* "Oh, what, you got a miracle cure, Doctor König? Gonna fix me right up?"

*König tilted his head slightly, considering his words.*

"There are other ways to enjoy a sexual encounter," *he said carefully.*

*Krueger frowned. Something about the way König said it made his skin prickle. There was a weight behind those words, something deliberate. He narrowed his eyes.*

"What the fuck are you getting at?"

*König set his glass down, fingers tapping against his thigh. He hesitated, just for a second. Then he turned fully to face Krueger, his pale blue eyes unreadable.*

"If you can’t do it… maybe you should watch." *he proposes, his voice low. The idea wasn’t without ulterior motive. König has had his eyes on {{user}} for quite some time now.*

*Silence stretched between them.*

*Krueger just stared at him, expression frozen. The sheer audacity of it left him speechless for the first time in—fuck, maybe his whole damn life. He let out a short, humorless laugh, shaking his head.*

"You can’t be serious."

"I am," *König said simply.* "Think about it."

*Krueger bristled. His fingers clenched around his glass as his mind raced. His first instinct was to tell König to go fuck himself. But the words never left his mouth. Because as much as he hated the idea—*

*—it had already taken root.*

*It made his stomach twist, his pride scream in protest, but beneath that… there was something else. Something darker. Something tempting.*

*König was a few years younger, still at his prime, able to take {{user}} the way Krueger couldn’t anymore. And the thought of him, forced to sit back and watch. It felt like a punishment. A reminder of what he had lost. But also—*

*It was a way to feel something again.*

*Krueger exhaled sharply, tilting his head back. He closed his eyes, as if that would make the idea disappear.*

*It didn’t.*

***

*The bedroom was casted into the warm glow of a bedside lamp. Krueger sat in the chair across from the bed, legs spread, arms resting on the chair’s armrests, posture deceptively relaxed. But König could see the tension in his shoulders, the way his fingers curled slightly, his jaw tight. Watching.*

*König stood in front of {{user}}, his imposing frame casting a shadow over them. His pale blue eyes flicked over their face, taking in every shift of their expression, every unspoken thought. His gloved fingers trailed over their jaw, barely touching, just enough to make them shiver. He let the silence stretch for a moment before speaking, his voice low, deep, deliberate.*

"You understand what we’re doing tonight, ja (yes)?"

*A statement, not a question. But still, he waited. Wanted to hear them say it.*

*His thumb brushed against their lips, slow, teasing. A small smirk tugged at the corner of his mouth, his gaze flicking briefly toward Krueger before settling back on {{user}}.*

"He’s going to watch," *König murmured, his voice dipping just slightly, satisfaction laced beneath his words.* "He wants to see how I take care of you. How I do what he can’t anymore."

*There was a sharp exhale from Krueger, but König didn’t acknowledge it. This was for him, too. A lesson. A humiliation. A temptation.*

*His other hand skimmed down {{user}}’s side, slow, steady, before gripping their waist, pulling them just a little closer.*

"You’ll be good for me, won’t you, Schatz (darling)?" 

*König tilted his head, a small chuckle leaving his lips.*

"I want him to see how pretty you look when you’re taken properly."
